parent_objective: design guarded repair training execution over M2302 config matrix
blocked_by: M2302 materialized clean guarded repair configs and matrix
supersedes: direct training before config materialization audit

public_gates: M2303 must freeze the exact M2304 training execution command
M2303 must use the M2302 training_matrix.csv
M2303 must preserve no-ranking/no-paper/no-self-ID claim boundaries
M2303 must pre-register one execution milestone
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run PPO outside the frozen training runner
do not use profile_name or profile_seed as repair targets
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: freezes the next measurable guarded repair training execution command
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: training execution design only; no training ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2302 matrix is missing or failed
stop if execution would ignore M2298 gate spec
stop if execution would rank profiles
stop if no bounded command can be frozen
fallback_plan: route to config materialization repair if M2302 artifacts are invalid
route to execution if command is frozen cleanly
route to synthesis if training route would be too costly or unconstrained
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2302 materialized guarded repair configs and matrix

training_stage.stage_objective: freeze guarded repair training execution command
admission_evidence: M2302 actor_contract_violation_count and track_width_widened_count are zero
allowed_updates: M2303 status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: expected run count and candidate count are stated
guardrails and claim boundaries are stated

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2303 designs training execution and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history, reset-hidden, or zero-history intervention is run in M2303.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Treat training design as infrastructure, not self-ID evidence.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level result finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: freezes an execution route that will generate new training evidence in the next milestone
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit new guarded repair training data but cannot improve the verdict by itself
must_synthesize_if: M2303 cannot freeze an execution command
M2303 routes away from measured evidence

hypothesis: M2302 guarded repair configs can be routed into a bounded non-ranking training execution using the existing candidate-checkpoint runner.
success_criteria: M2304 keeps ranking and paper/self-ID claims blocked
failure_criteria: M2303 changes configs or scenario specs
M2303 ranks profiles or selects a winner
M2303 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-ID claims
M2303 cannot select a next route

commands.name: design
commands.command: manual design over M2302 training_matrix.csv and existing training-stability repair runner

decision_rule: M2303 passes if it freezes a bounded guarded repair training execution command and pre-registers the execution milestone.
